message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts: illegal cultivation of poppy (罂粟) with opiate alkaloids. In Chinese criminal law, cultivation of poppy for opium is a crime of "非法种植罂粟" which falls under "走私、贩卖、运输、制造毒品罪" or specifically "非法种植罂粟罪". The relevant article is 347 of Criminal Law: "非法种植罂粟或者其他罂粟品种的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "非法种植罂粟罪". In the examples, they label as "非法种植罂粟" maybe "非法种植罂粟" or "非法种植罂粟罪". The answer format: [罪名]...;...<eoa>. Only one crime. So answer: [罪名]非法种植罂粟罪<eoa>.
